chapter: Paul Barbarin and his own bands
title: Playing on the excursion boats
summary: He says he played on a boat for a charity party with his own outfit and a couple of times with Paul Barbarin, but never on the regular excursions.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: No, I worked... I was on the boat lately with an outfit I had of my own. Made of outfit. And of... A party for... Dr. Edmund Shusian was affiliated because he was the one that recommended me to the club... The Christophers, the name of the club. They had a party for the benefit of underprivileged Jewish children, I think, or something like that. And I was engaged to play on the president for that occasion. And I played on the boat a couple times with Paul Barberin, but I never did make those excursions that you were fine to. I never did make those. I mean, just never get around to it.
